title: Airflow DAG SLA Misses
dataSources: Airflow logs (`airflow:scheduler`, `airflow:task`), Airflow StatsD/OTel metrics, dbt `run_results.json`/`sources.json` (`dbt:run_results`), dbt Cloud API run history, Dagster/Prefect run events.
app: Apache Airflow scheduler/worker logs and StatsD/OTel metrics via HEC; dbt run-results/manifest artifacts and dbt Cloud API via HEC scripted inputs; Dagster/Prefect event logs.
spl:
index=dataops sourcetype=airflow:scheduler event=sla_miss
| stats count as misses, latest(_time) as last_miss by dag_id, task_id
| where misses>0
| sort - misses
description: Captures Airflow SLA-miss events so pipelines that finish late (even if they finish) are caught against their business deadline.
value: A pipeline that lands data after the morning report is effectively failed; SLA-miss tracking enforces the deadline that matters to the business.
implementation: Enable SLAs on critical tasks and ingest sla_miss events; schedule hourly; alert on misses for deadline-bound DAGs.
visualization: Table of SLA misses by DAG, timechart.
grandmaExplanation: We flag when data workflows finish too late for the people waiting on the numbers, even if they eventually finish.
